test_title: PYST 34: SSC CHSL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 14 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option in which the letter-clusters share the same relationship as that shared by the given pair of letter- clusters.

NCZ : UIV

BIL: IOH
solution:
Here, we use the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/383cbc439a6704dc9f007ece7c80e348b39e04936c661f4f7549620715750585.png] ​

**Logic: '7' and '6' are added to the positional values of the first and second alphabet and '4' is subtracted from the positional value of the third alphabet.**

**Given:**

NCZ : UIV →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c24e27b67fb09f0a98f6648673704e8e6b9d7024137d7444de384380230f70fa.png] 

BIL: IOH →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1bd4a232bae91168571c806cbc8fec70716d23c905c35d20570b3de8323c843c.png] 

Checking the given options:

**1.** IUN : PAJ →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/912b12d499e72dbdffa850e4bae34c7600be19ea47dd1854dba2729ad14de012.png] 

**2.** TAP : AET →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6d2b7592b44692cd0c7bfdf7b5098b629b31d1091e05154850ee140829060364.png] 

**3.** PIL : IOP →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4c7026763d80ffd1ae56964e464edeaed20aba4d801daf52ddee6decc47d37c1.png] 

**4.** AOR : JUM →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f3a5f49f52db0723e37a072572af3184eaa35a09e12e462b99d1cea484122484.png] 

Here, **'IUN : PAJ'** is similar to the given sets of the alphabet.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (1)".
